turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Sofia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am extremely unhappy. My card was declined at a hospital.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a bad place for that to happen. I'm sorry. Let me look right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see it — a fraud rule triggered on an out-of-state medical merchant. That's our error.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It was. I've cleared the block and whitelisted that merchant category for you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm also crediting the late fee that resulted, and noting the account so it can't recur.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I appreciate you actually fixing it instead of reading me a script.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Try the card now if you'd like to confirm.

action_items: Credit late fee caused by declined transaction
labels.notes: High initial anger that resolves. Tests that escalation_risk is not a pure function of negative sentiment.
